claim_limit: One receipt-less Link-35 hardware pre-smoke plus read-only post-stop captures. It is not hardware acceptance, promotion, latency evidence or authorization for another product or diagnostic link.

proved: the Link-35 non-LTO completion leaf ran far enough to observe the chained 0xa5 marker
the exact deployed Boot-family source remained byte-identical
the first verifier transport nevertheless failed its payload CRC before verifier entry
